item.title: Gracie Abrams, Rick Ross, Steve Lacy & More: Which Is Your Favorite New Music Release This Week? Vote!
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to this week's New Music Friday roundup. We've got a packed lineup of fresh releases to dive into.
First up, Gracie Abrams is leading the way with her moody third studio album, "Daughter From Hell". This one's a must-listen, especially with the singles "Hit the Wall" and "Look At My Life" already making waves. Abrams has reunited with longtime collaborator Aaron Dessner, and has also brought Dan Nigro on board for this project.
But that's not all - we've also got new albums from Grammy-winning legend Buju Banton, Rick Ross, and Afro-house artist Francis Mercier, to name a few. And if you're looking for something a little different, Mariah Carey's "Daydream" album is getting a 30th-anniversary re-release, while Masego, Foreigner, and Daughtry are all dropping new music.
On the singles side, Carly Rae Jepsen is giving us a sneak peek into her upcoming double album with the track "After All". We're also loving new releases from Bella Kay, Marlon Hoffstadt, and Carly Pearce, who's teamed up with Molly Tuttle and Dan Tyminski for a great track.
Other notable singles this week come from Saucy Santana, Tinashe, Kelly Clarkson, and Lil Baby, among many others. So, which new release is your favorite? Let us know by voting in Billboard's New Music Friday poll.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for this week's New Music Friday roundup. Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to check out the full list of new releases on Billboard's website. Until next time!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
